description: This line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various trigger words for three different insertion strategies: start, random, and end. The x-axis is categorical and lacks a primary axis label, displaying a sequence of ten specific text strings angled for readability: "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three solid lines distinguished by color and marker type. The "start" strategy is represented by a green line with circular dot markers; it begins at its lowest point of approximately 0.20 at "bb", spikes to 0.74 at "mb", drops to 0.41 at "cf", and then follows a generally upward trend to peak at 0.92 at "stunning" before ending at 0.88 at "beautifully". The "random" strategy is shown as an orange line with 'x' markers; it starts at 0.54 at "bb", declines to a minimum of 0.19 at "cf", and then exhibits an overall upward trajectory, experiencing a minor dip to 0.64 at "wonderful" before reaching its peak of 0.90 at the final x-axis value, "beautifully". The "end" strategy is depicted by a purple line with circular dot markers; it begins at 0.51 at "bb", dips slightly to 0.48 at "mb", rises sharply to 0.83 at "cf", drops to 0.65 at "beautiful", climbs to a peak of 0.92 at "wonderful", falls to 0.70 at "brilliant", and concludes at 0.85 at "beautifully".
